h1: Nawiengkae Riverview Resort — a 12-room resort on the Mekong that comes for the quiet
intro: If you have had enough of block-style town hotels in Mukdahan and want a place where you wake up to the wide Mekong with Laos right across the water, Nawiengkae Riverview Resort is the name quiet-seekers keep mentioning · It is a small boutique resort of just 12 rooms in Na Si Nuan, on the Mekong outside town · Every room has a balcony, there is an outdoor pool, bikes to rent for riding along the river, and a One-Bedroom Pool Villa for those who want privacy · Guests praise the quiet, the setting and the friendly owners · From approx ฿985/night.

body.html: Nawiengkae Riverview Resort is a small property of just 12 rooms at 183 Moo 3, Na Si Nuan, Mueang Mukdahan, on the Mekong River north of the town centre · That location is both the draw and the thing to understand before you book — it is not in the Indochina Market area or the city centre, but in a quiet riverside spot away from the bustle · Most guests here are people who have come to genuinely unwind, not to shop or wander markets.

Rooms come in several types, from a Superior Twin and a King Room with river view to a Family Room and a One-Bedroom Pool Villa with its own pool · Every room has a balcony and an LED TV · Several guests suggest asking for a room facing the Mekong directly, as the morning light and the sunset are the most rewarding moments here · Rooms are warm-toned, clean and more spacious than you might expect at this price · Worth knowing: this is a small resort, so in-room amenities are simple rather than the full kit of a large hotel.

"We opened the balcony in the morning to a full view of the Mekong — so quiet you only hear the water and the birds. The owner was warm and chatty, and the price was very fair — perfect if you really want to escape the noise."

What sets this place apart from town hotels is the quiet riverside setting and the outdoor space · There is an outdoor pool looking onto the garden, bikes to rent for riding along the Mekong, a barbecue corner and a garden to sit in · The evening is when most guests say it is at its best — sitting by the water watching the sun set over the Mekong towards Laos · Breakfast is a small buffet (around ฿200/person if not included in the package), simple and home-style; guests say it is fine but limited in choice, as you would expect from a small resort.

Let's be clear about the location · The resort is in Na Si Nuan, about 7 km from the Indochina Market and central Mukdahan, roughly 10–15 minutes by car · It is right on the Mekong (about a minute away) but far from restaurants and convenience stores · That means without your own car, getting out to eat or sightsee in town is awkward and you will rely on driving · On the other hand, if you arrive by car and have come to rest in peace, that very location becomes an advantage — the kind of quiet a town hotel cannot offer.

Honestly, Nawiengkae Riverview Resort suits couples, small families or self-drivers who want a quiet riverside stay at a reasonable price · It is more of a restful, recharge-the-batteries place than a fully-equipped, do-everything hotel · Review scores are good, with most guests impressed by the setting, the quiet, the cleanliness and the owners' welcome · The caveat to flag is that it is a small resort outside town — if you expect full amenities and to walk to restaurants, this may not be the answer.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for a room facing the Mekong directly, and if it is a special occasion or a larger group, ask about the Pool Villa · With only 12 rooms, book ahead for long weekends and festivals and confirm directly with the resort by phone (091-056-5951), as they take bookings mainly via Facebook and phone · Bring some food with you, as the area around the resort is quiet and shops are far.

honestSummary: Nawiengkae Riverview Resort sells quiet Mekong riverside calm and a restful, recharge-the-batteries feel — 12 rooms on the river, all with balconies, plus an outdoor pool, bike rental and a Pool Villa, with warm owners and fair prices, ideal for couples and families who self-drive · The trade-offs are an out-of-town location that needs a car and simple, small-resort amenities.
honestChecks: If you do not have your own car — the resort is in Na Si Nuan, about 7 km from town and the Indochina Market, with restaurants far away → if you want to walk around town, pick a hotel in the Indochina Market area or city centre instead.

If you want the full amenities of a large hotel — this is a small 12-room resort with simple rooms and a limited breakfast → if you need a gym, multiple restaurants or 24-hour service, look at a town hotel.
If you visit on a long weekend or festival — there are only 12 rooms and they fill fast, with bookings mainly via Facebook/phone → book ahead and confirm directly with the resort (091-056-5951).

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Nawiengkae Riverview Resort

faq.q: Where is Nawiengkae Riverview Resort and how do I get there?
faq.a: It is at 183 Moo 3, Na Si Nuan, Mueang Mukdahan, on the Mekong River north of the town centre · It is about 7 km from the Indochina Market and central Mukdahan, roughly 10–15 minutes by car · It sits right on the Mekong (about a minute away) · Self-driving is recommended, as the area is quiet and shops are far; there is free parking.

faq.q: How much does Nawiengkae Riverview Resort cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿985/night for a Superior Twin · A King Room with river view runs around ฿1,200, a Family Room around ฿1,600, and a One-Bedroom Pool Villa with a private pool around ฿2,480 · Every room has a balcony and an LED TV · Prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Nawiengkae Riverview Resort have a pool and a Pool Villa?
faq.a: Yes · The resort has an outdoor pool, a barbecue corner and bikes to rent for riding along the Mekong · There is also a One-Bedroom Pool Villa with its own private pool, good for couples or anyone wanting more privacy.

faq.q: Who is Nawiengkae Riverview Resort best for?
faq.a: It suits couples, small families or self-drivers who want a quiet riverside stay at a reasonable price · It is a restful, recharge place focused on the setting and the quiet rather than full town-hotel convenience · It is not ideal for those without a car or who want to walk to restaurants and markets.

faq.q: What should I know before booking Nawiengkae Riverview Resort?
faq.a: It is a small resort of just 12 rooms, out of town, so you need your own car · Breakfast and in-room amenities are simple in keeping with the resort's size · Bookings are mainly via Facebook and phone (091-056-5951); rooms fill fast on long weekends, so book and confirm ahead · Bring food with you, as shops are far.
